title: THREE LANES
description: The claim in condensed display type, then a six-year record in three lanes, phone, web and server, newest first: real screens sit in the lane they run in, under a red Today line. Offday fills all three lanes in the first row.
signature: Big Shoulders Display (claim 66px/700, years 44px/800, lane headers 20px caps) for the claim, years and lane headers; Libre Franklin 16px text; Martian Mono 13px facts. Warm paper oklch(97% 0.008 50) and ink oklch(21% 0.012 50) with one red, oklch(50% 0.19 25), the calendars' today line: it marks Today, focus and link hover. The one motion: the year bars draw down once when the record enters view, 600 ms cubic-bezier(0.16, 1, 0.3, 1), 25 ms stagger; hovering or focusing an entry lights its bar in 150 ms. Reduced motion draws the bars complete.
rule: the page is a six-year record in three lanes, phone, web and server; every product sits in the lane it runs in and the year it shipped, so the lanes fill in from phone to web to server
designRead: Reading this as: a phone-and-web developer who moved to full stack, for a hiring manager on a phone, leading with Offday (one product in all three lanes), in a dated record of three lanes.
hook: The site where the work is laid out in three lanes, phone, web and server, and the server lane is empty until 2026.
lead: Offday, 2026: the only product that runs in all three lanes at once, so the first row is the claim drawn as a picture; it is the owner's own full-stack product, and the other drafts lead with the care platform, Bayyinah TV and the store apps. The care platform rebuild and its server are the second row.
composition: 3 (the claim drawn as a picture: three lanes are the sentence) crossed with 4 (a dated record, years down the page). Differs from the round's other drafts, which open on sentence + proof row + one framed screen, a driven mechanism, or one material idea.

fourAnswers.desktop: who: Gentrit Rashiti (masthead, claim) / what: phone and web apps, and since 2026 the servers behind them / for whom: care teams, readers and shoppers / proof: Offday's real team calendar and phone screen in the first row, links to bayyinahtv.com, the App Store, Google Play and GitHub, the years 2021, 2023 and 2026
fourAnswers.phone: who: Gentrit Rashiti / what: phone and web apps / for whom: care teams, readers and shoppers / proof: the since-years line, the four links, the three lane headers with their years, Today and 2026, and Offday's October calendar starting at about y=540

allowed: C17: the first screen is complete at the 900 ms frame; the later largest paint is a below-fold image painted during the checker's scripted scroll on the unbundled dev server (phone LCP 668 ms)
T23: the only hover-lift rule on the page is the site's shared Tailwind utility (.hover:-translate-y-1), which no element of this draft uses

holdback: Hook 7 and original 7: the rule is structural, not a moment. The visitor drives nothing; the bars draw once and a hover lights one of them. The memory sentence is a fact about the layout (the empty server lane until 2026), and a lane-and-year record is a known shape even if the lanes are this person's. By the skill's own rule this draft should go back to direct, not to polish.
skillNotes: Helped: the direction card forced rule, hook and delete test before code, and the 'finding the rule' steps (ten true facts, combine one with something the reader can see) produced the lanes from the role line 'since 2026 also the server'. first-screen.md's formula and word budget, the composition list and 'design the phone, do not shrink' were followed line by line. writing.md's translation table (component → building block, tenant → organization) matched what the checker later flagged. visual.md's starting-points table gave a non-reflex display face with a written reason, and its size-adjust fallback advice took CLS from 0.066 to 0.003. The meta-tag allow mechanism worked and shows as ○ in the report. The checker's density test (C08b/C08c) forced honest crops, and data-work on the crop box made the first-screen share accurate. Unclear, wrong or missing: (1) visual.md's 'font-display: optional for the display face' is wrong for a lazy route on a cold load: the checker captured the fallback sans while reporting 'Big Shoulders Display' as the hero face, because it reads the computed family, not the rendered one; swap + preload + a size-adjusted local fallback is the working recipe, and the checker should verify with document.fonts.check. (2) Hard rule 1 says work ≥ 25%/20%, but check.mjs fails only below 15%/12% and treats 25% as a soft signal; say which is the gate. (3) reference/checks.md does not exist although SKILL.md and the brief cite it, 'check.mjs --list' is not a flag (it tries to navigate to '--list'), and data/phrases.json, which the source says feeds T10–T10f, is missing, so the technical-word list C can only be learned by tripping it (it flags 'tiers', 'runtime', 'deep link', 'IVS', 'CSP'). (4) --facts CONTENT.md is accepted but no number check runs; the skill promises T45. (5) New ids appeared mid-round (C17, T10f, 'with canvas/video outside data-work') with no doc, as the brief warned. (6) C17 measures LCP across the checker's own scripted scroll, so a below-fold lazy image becomes 'largest paint at 4.1 s' on desktop while the t900 frame shows the first screen complete; freeze LCP at the first scroll or read the frames. (7) work-display.md says crop to the part that proves the caption, but gives no technique: object-fit cannot crop to a region, and with a translated img inside an aspect-ratio box the density test needs the crop to be ≥ 1.74× the box width (scale ≤ 0.575); a snippet and that number belong in the reference. (8) first-screen.md's 'work starts above 500px' on a phone does not add up with its own element list (masthead, 4-line claim at 38px, second line, a proof row of 44px targets, nav): the sum is about 520px; relax to 560 or allow the proof row below the work. (9) C05b warns for short text links in a spaced row ('CV', 'Case') although the skill says spaced nav links may be smaller; the checker's exemption only covers links inside long text, and 'CV' needs min-width, which no reference mentions. (10) snippets/press-and-hover.css draws link underlines with background-image, and the checker's T12c read my proof links styled that way as 'two boxed buttons under the hero'; a text-decoration underline passed. The snippet and the detector disagree. (11) directions.md's mechanisms reward a control the visitor drives (M2/M5/M12); a purely structural rule (M1 + M13 + M14) cannot score above 7 on hook by review.md's wording, and the skill should say so before the builder commits, and the card should ask 'what is the rule on a 390px screen?'. (12) The draft-notes template and the brief's meta.json keys differ from the picker's DraftMeta type (no fourAnswers, loopScores, pageLength); harmless, but undocumented.
